title: School Days
subtitle: 考点：时间与原因 / I like Thursday because ...

dialogue.t: What time do we start school in the morning, Tom?
We start at eight. We have four lessons before lunch.
Two lessons. On Thursday we have a ping-pong club after school.
Because I can play ping-pong with my friends.

vocab: start 开始 · lesson 课 · ping-pong 乒乓球 · because 因为 · Thursday 星期四 · answer 回答

questions.why: We have four lessons before lunch.
